headline: As New York City Ballet’s Shoe Colorist, Tim Foster Brings a Niche and Needed Craft
context: Tim Foster is a shoe colorist for New York City Ballet, an unexpected but, thanks to a new documentary, no longer unsung hero who practices a delicate, painstaking art.
